reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-08: Nest nest-vault-positions API reports NAV $62,237,423.92 with settled position.value holdings and a $350,000 PendingDeposit on ETH OALS2T. Compiled per the nest-vault-positions adapter (which includes pending deposits for nOPAL reconciliation), normalized 1-dp slices are: BlackOpal LiquidStone II OALS2T $58,814,530.29 (94.5%), nTBILL $2,073,202.02 (3.3%), pending OALS2T deposit $350,000 (0.6%), USDT $667,111.26 (1.1%), USDC $257,650.46 (0.4%), and pUSD $87,523.88 (0.1%), summing to 100.0%. Slice names mirror the adapter's verbatim output. The nBASIS sleeve carries a zero balance and creates no slice. Obligor-level FIDC composition remains unpublished, so the private-credit slices (settled + pending) stay known-unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest live vault-positions API, price/NAV API, and last-price-update API re-opened 2026-08-08, compiled per the nest-vault-positions adapter; corroborated by Nest/BlackOpal structural disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The LiquidStone II FIDC's obligor-level receivable composition, FIDC service providers, and any fund-level financial audit are not public; OALS2T valuation prices are Nest/API-supplied even where token amounts are on-chain-verified. The stablecoin and nTBILL legs are fully identified. A Nest Basis Vault (nBASIS) target component currently carries a zero balance and creates no slice.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Nest documents that underlying-asset cash and securities sit with third-party custodians rather than Nest itself, and BlackOpal describes LiquidStone II as a single-investor sub-fund of a Brazilian FIDC holding receivables acquired via true sale, which supports segregated, bankruptcy-remote treatment. The FIDC's custodian, administrator, and obligor-level positions are not named publicly, no fund-level financial attestation exists, and rehypothecation terms are not published.

controls.label: Nest vault owner Safe (3-of-6)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295023, getOwners() returned 6 addresses; getThreshold() = 3. modules() returned sentinel only (no modules). guard slot (0x4a204f...) = 0x00. masterCopy slot = 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea (Safe v1.3.0 L1 mainnet). Shared with nBASIS vault.

review.evidence: Both nOPAL Teller (0xA5F8e5...) and Manager (0xea452B...) return owner() = 0xa08a0dc... at Ethereum block 25295023. That address is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 confirmed via getOwners(), getThreshold(), modules(), guard storage slot, and masterCopy slot. This is the same Safe that owns the nBASIS vault contracts. No modules, no guard. All reads on-chain via publicnode ETH RPC. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nOPAL supply to portfolio assets was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer.
